meta.note: The approved brand-list API does not supply outlet count, average sales, royalty, or a standalone interior amount. totalInvestment represents only the KFTC startup-amount components total (합계금액), not all real on-site costs. Unknown fields are omitted. Values are shown at base-year 2025 (브랜드·법인·대/중분류 업종이 모두 일치하는 경우에만 연결; 불일치 또는 충돌 금액은 미표시).
